description: In every PA-model, each \(n\) has a positive common multiple of all positive \(j\le n\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.common_multiple_model.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  (n : M) :
  ∃ d,
    d ≠ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M ∧
      ∀ (i : M),
        i ≠ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M →
          Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M i n →
            Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.DividesModel M i d
